title: Mega menu
description: A flyout of links in category columns: a text-overline header per column, links with a grey icon, a hint and a New badge, and a See all link. AppShell opens it beside the sidebar from a nav item with mega; an app can open it from its own trigger.
when: One sidebar item leads to many destinations of one area that fall into 2–4 groups (a catalogue, tools, reports).
A top-bar item of an app with that kind of area (placement="bottom").

instead.need: 2–6 views of one area that people switch between often

a11y: A non-modal dialog named after its trigger; the trigger has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.
Focus moves to the first link; ↑/↓ move between links; Escape or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the trigger; Tab out of the panel closes it.
Column headers are headings (h2) and each column is a labelled section.
notes: In AppShell give the nav item `mega: { columns, seeAll }`: on phones the drawer shows the same links as a drill-down level.
Column titles are written in sentence case: text-overline renders them uppercase (C-032, the only place besides sidebar and palette group labels).
Give every link an icon, or none; at most one New badge per column.

examples.title: From a button
examples.description: placement="bottom" under its own trigger; in AppShell it opens beside the sidebar.
